title: Dermalogica Clearing Defense SPF30 Review: Matte SPF for Breakout-Prone Skin, How to Use It
description:
Dermalogica Clearing Defense SPF30: a shine-reducing SPF moisturizer that helps protect breakout-prone skin from environmental stress, with a long-lasting matte finish.

We earn a commission if you buy through our link.

• Shine-reducing SPF moisturizer that helps protect breakout-prone skin from environmental stress (59 ml)
• Broad spectrum SPF30; active filters homosalate 8%, octocrylene 8%, octisalate 5%, avobenzone 3%
• Natural tapioca helps reduce shine for a long-lasting matte finish
• Willow bark extract, green tea extract and vitamin C help combat the irritating effects of pollution
• Apply a generous amount to cleansed face and neck, preferably 30 minutes before sun exposure; reapply as recommended
• Very dry skin may feel drier; layer a hydrating lotion underneath
